description_short: Demo of SARIMA model on airline passenger time series data
description: This is a demonstration of a Seasonal ARIMA (SARIMA) model applied to the classic airline passenger dataset. SARIMA extends ARIMA by capturing seasonal patterns in addition to trend and autoregressive components. The model uses SARIMA(1,1,1)(1,1,1,12) to forecast monthly passenger numbers.

inputs.name: Q
